5086-5183-5231-6824-7824.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
5086-5183-5231-6824-7824.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 1.

183-3652-3661-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
183-3652-3661-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

2506-4836-6441-7150.description:
Cast Kirol by paying {1}{R/W}{R/W}
When Kirol enters, Molten Echoes triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kirol by tapping it and another creature you control, copying Molten Echoes's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Molten Echoes's ability, creating two token copies of Kirol with haste.
Holding priority, activate a Kirol token by tapping both Kirol tokens, copying Molten Echoes's trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

3059-7186-7408.description:
Cast Malignus by paying {3}{R}{R}. It'll enter with power equal to half the highest life total among your opponents, rounded up.
When Malignus enters, Champion of the Path triggers, causing Malignus to deal damage equal to its power doubled to each opponent due to Collective Inferno.
3059-7186-7408.notes: Malignus also makes the damage unpreventable due to its static effect. This combo should result in each opponent losing the game except in niche circumstances.

3490-4369-4659-7278.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature with power 1 or greater to enter the battlefield under your control.
3490-4369-4659-7278.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Slash triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
The Red Terror triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Slash triggers.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}.
Resolve the Slash triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

719-5331-7082.description:
Cast Gemcutter Buccaneer by paying {3}{R}. When it enters, Gemcutter Buccaneer triggers, creating a tapped Treasure token that enters as an Equipment.
When the Treasure enters, Sokka and Suki triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token which enters as a Pirate due to Xenograft.
When the Ally enters, Gemcutter Buccaneer triggers, creating a tapped Treasure token that enters as an Equipment.
Repeat from step 2.
719-5331-7082.notes: The combo creates a mandatory infinite loop in step 2. This must be stopped at some point or the game ends in a draw.

3129-4017-4659-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
3129-4017-4659-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Triskelavus triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}
Repeat from step 1.

3490-6006-6791-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-6006-6791-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

2350-3532-3761-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
2350-3532-3761-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Arcbound Crusher triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Crusher.
Repeat.

2173-2292-5220-6537.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Tarpan.
When Tarpan dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tarpan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Tarpan trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Tarpan from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Bolas's Citadel.
Repeat.

2530-2577-5789-6518.easyPrerequisites: You control another Zombie if Gravecrawler is in your graveyard.
2530-2577-5789-6518.description:
Cast Gravecrawler either from your hand or graveyard by paying {B}.
When Gravecrawler enters the battlefield, Lifecreed Duo, Carnival of Souls and The Sibsig Ceremony trigger.
Resolve the Lifecreed Duo trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Resolve the Sibsig Ceremony trigger, destroying Gravecrawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When the Zombie Druid enters the battlefield, Lifecreed Duo and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Lifecreed Duo trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Repeat.

586-1796-2921-5258-5618.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {1}
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

856-2267-5147-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Tormod trigger.
Resolve the Tormod trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

4802-4929-5224.description:
Cast Cryptic Trilobite by paying {0}, causing it to enter the battlefield with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Master Biomancer.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat step 4 until Cryptic Trilobite dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
When Cryptic Trilobite dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Cryptic Trilobite from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

478-804-2734-2821-3573.manaNeeded: {7}{U}{U}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
478-804-2734-2821-3573.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
478-804-2734-2821-3573.description:
Animate Candelabra using Cyberdrive Awakener
Cast Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2}{U}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Candelabra of Tawnos that is still named Sakashima the Impostor and legendary.
Activate Tolarian Academy by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Minamo and Tolarian Academy.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Sakashima the Impostor.
Repeat from step 3.

6-2752-5261.notablePrerequisites:
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {5}{G}.
Elder Druid does not have summoning sickness.
Vitalize exiled by Isochron Scepter.
6-2752-5261.description:
Activate any number of creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {5}{G}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Vitalize without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Vitalize, untapping all creatures you control.
Activate Elder Druid by paying {3}{G} and tapping it, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

2092-3719-4661-5326.notablePrerequisites: Vesuvan Doppelganger and Agatha of the Vile Cauldron each have a power of at least 2.
2092-3719-4661-5326.description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Vesuvan Doppelganger and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Vesuvan Doppelganger from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Vesuvan Doppelganger to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Vesuvan Doppelganger enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Vesuvan Doppelganger by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

190-389-3629-6126.easyPrerequisites: Cloudsteel Kirin attached to a creature you control.
190-389-3629-6126.description:
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling Nine Lives and causing each opponent to create a token copy of it.
Nine Lives leaves the battlefield, however you cannot lose the game due to Cloudsteel Kirin.
Cast Merciless Eviction by paying its mana cost, exiling all enchantments.
When each opponent's Nine Lives leaves the battlefield, they each trigger, causing each opponent to lose the game.

575-1207-2167.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional nontoken Forest.
575-1207-2167.description:
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing a nontoken Forest, which is a creature due to Ambush Commander, adding {G}.
When the Forest dies, Yedora triggers, returning the Forest from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Repeat.

527-3869-4067.notablePrerequisites: Selvala does not have summoning sickness. You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
527-3869-4067.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {2}{G}{G}{U}.
Activate Gretchen by tapping {2}{G}{U}, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Selvala.
Repeat.

2511-2584-4133.description:
Cast Soul Collector by paying {3}{B}{B}.
When Soul Collector enters the battlefield, Pandemonium triggers, causing Soul Collector to deal damage to itself equal to its power.
If an ability from Bloodflow Connoisseur is waiting to resolve, let it resolve.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Soul Collector.
When Soul Collector dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

643-3168-3859-5613.description:
Cast Cavern Harpy by paying {0}.
When Cavern Harpy enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

213-2232-5013.notablePrerequisites:
Myojin of Life's Web has at least two divinity counters on it.
You have at least one other nonartifact creature card in hand.
213-2232-5013.description:
Activate Myojin of Life's Web by removing a divinity counter from it, putting Bloom Hulk and another nonartifact creature from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Bloom Hulk and the additional creature enter the battlefield, Bloom Hulk triggers once and Cloudstone Curio triggers twice.
Resolve the Bloom Hulk trigger, putting a divinity counter on Myojin of Life's Web.
Resolve both Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Bloom Hulk and the additional creature to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

643-1869-2232-2792.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}.
643-1869-2232-2792.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}.
Cast Great Whale by paying {5}{U}{U}.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it, Cloudstone Curio and Inalla trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Great Whale trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}.
Resolve the Inalla trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Great Whale with haste.
When the Great Whale token enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the nontoken Great Whale to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Great Whale trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat.

643-1869-3089-3821.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}.
643-1869-3089-3821.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying {4}{U}.
When Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it and Inalla trigger.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}.
Resolve the Inalla trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Peregrine Drake.
When the Peregrine Drake token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Activate Barrin by paying {2} and sacrificing the Peregrine Drake token, returning the nontoken Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1812-3525-3784.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Vhal.
Vhal does not have summoning sickness.
1812-3525-3784.description:
Activate Vhal by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C} that cannot be spent to cast spells from your hand.
Activate Prismite by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Vhal.
Repeat.

618-914-5200.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of the Paruns attached to Kiki-Jiki.
Opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments.
618-914-5200.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Dockside Extortionist.
The Dockside Extortionist token enters the battlefield, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.

1030-1537-2034.notablePrerequisites: Othelm does not have summoning sickness.
1030-1537-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Zealous Conscripts, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Othelm by paying {2} and tapping it, returning Zealous Conscripts from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Zealous Conscripts enters the battlefield, untapping Othelm.
Repeat.

1558-1692-3529-4231.notablePrerequisites:
Helm of the Host attached to Academy Manufactor.
Hoard Robber does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by at least one opponent.
1558-1692-3529-4231.description:
At the beginning of your combat step, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Academy Manufactor.
Attack with Hoard Robber.
Hoard Robber triggers on combat damage to a player, creating three Treasure tokens, three Food tokens, and three Clue tokens.
Activate Time Sieve's ability by tapping Time Sieve and sacrificing five artifacts you control, taking an extra turn after this one.
Repeat.

2103-2556-2665.notablePrerequisites:
Enough mana available to cast the extra turn spell each turn.
Progenitor Mimic is a copy of Mnemonic Wall.
2103-2556-2665.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Mnemonic Wall.
When the token Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
